note_history.10-Q.key_note_tags.from: the current 10-Q XBRL instance 10-Q/ubnt-20260331_htm.xml: every element whose local name ends in 'TextBlock' listed with ElementTree and a start-ns pass for the prefixes, importing nothing from src/, then each name read against the six key notes docs/INPUT_SPEC.md section 5 names — revenue_recognition_policy: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock (Note 'REVENUES'), us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerPolicyTextBlock (its disaggregation and contract-balances policy); critical_accounting_estimates: us-gaap:BusinessDescriptionAndBasisOfPresentationTextBlock ('BUSINESS AND BASIS OF PRESENTATION'), us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock ('SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES', which carries 'Use of Accounting Estimates').
